label: YouTube

routes.title: YouTube channel: signed-in browser profile
routes.guidance: Save your channel identity and a named browser profile. Assisted upload fills one video's title and description in YouTube Studio, then stops on Details. You finish audience, visibility and Publish/Save yourself. Attaching a video can create a private draft. No API upload or publishing permission is granted.

change_summary: Revision 3: named browser sign-in creates a YouTube channel account with an assisted upload route; API OAuth upload remains out of scope. No automatic read or post grant. Studio selectors and signed-in upload are unverified live. Revision 2 added sign-in evidence checked only in Chromium fixtures.
